idea-plugin.name: Git Guard
idea-plugin.description:
Prevents you from accidentally walking away from unfinished Git work.

When you close a project (or quit the IDE), Git Guard checks the current state of every Git repository in the project and shows a confirmation dialog if either of the following is true:

  • Uncommitted changes — modified, added, or deleted files in your working tree.
  • Unpushed commits — local commits that have not been pushed to the upstream branch, or commits on a branch that has no upstream configured.

You can still close the project at any time — the dialog just makes sure it is intentional.
